name: PROJECT IPHIS
source:
Ianthe is researching a way to make bionic humans free of flaws. Despite technology advancements -- there are still new diseases, mental illnesses, irrational decisions, and global conflicts. She does inhumane experiments on IPHIS, an antique android model, to create the ultimate perfect human being, the first dual-bionic-android-human.

[From [url=https://studioyurika.itch.io/project-iphis]itch.io[/url]]
